messages:
anya_release: Heads-up — planning Oberon Labs (Dedicated) slice deploy Thu Mar 12 02:00 UTC (quiet window). Need approvals: KMS rotation overlap check, version pin to v1.4.2-rc3, canary config (5% → 25% → 100%), and explicit rollback criteria. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/oberon/v1.4.2-rc3. Any blockers?

mike_sre: Quick note — customer has a KMS rotation scheduled Tue Mar 10 23:00 UTC. We need rotation finished at least 24h before deploy or we'll hit token invalidation risk. @anya_release can you confirm with Oberon?

laura_ops: We asked them. They can move rotation to Wed Mar 11 02:00 UTC, which gives ~24h+ buffer. They confirmed in writing to their security contact.

ben_pm: Release notes summary:
- model-decoder perf improvements (p95 down ~120ms)
- quantization fallback path for rare OOMs
- session cookie TTL change (impact: short sessions for some webhooks)
Customer-facing blurb drafted and linked in the release doc.

deploybot: deploybot queued job: deploy/oberon/slice-42 -> image redwood/infer:v1.4.2-rc3 @commit 9f3b7c. Canary steps loaded from /playbooks/oberon/canary.json. To abort: `/deploy abort 847321`.

```
# deploybot preview
job: 847321
target: oberon.slice-42
canary: [5%, 25%, 100%]
auto_rollback: enabled (policy: infra-errors >=5% for 3m OR p95 latency >2s for 5m)
```

kevin_infra: KV cache warmup plan: we'll prime top-5 prefixes with `kvprime --tenant oberon --prefix-list top5.txt` 10m before canary start. Setting prefix retention to 30m to avoid cold misses if we rollback. Also will pin CUDA kernel selection to stable for this image.

ops-runner: Clarifying rollback behavior: auto-rollback to v1.4.1 (stable) is enabled if thresholds hit. Manual rollback possible to `fallback-oberon-2025-02` by ops. We will also hold at 25% until manual thumbs-up for ramp to 100% unless metrics are green for 30m.

anya_release: Sounds good. I will pin v1.4.2-rc3 in the console and attach the release notes. @mike_sre please run the synthetic traffic sim at 01:30 UTC and post results here.

mike_sre: Will run sim at 01:30 UTC (profiles: baseline, burst, cold-start). I'll share a short log snippet in-thread.

laura_ops: I approve the window from ops side. :thumbsup: Will escalate to oncall 30m prior if anything flares.

ben_pm: I approve product/pm side. Will send the customer-facing message after go/no-go.

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled 847321 for Thu 02:00 UTC. Notifying #eng-oncall, #customer-success, and the tenant slack. Canary timeline: 0m=5% -> 20m=25% -> 45m=100%. Auto-rollback rules persisted.

ops-runner: Security flag — if KMS rotation occurs within 48h of deploy, fallback will route tenant to 'fallback-kms' path which may cause short downtime. Prefer to avoid a rotation in that window. Confirmed with SecOps.

kevin_infra: Noted and added the KMS conditional in the runbook (section 4.2). Also added a quick script to validate key availability pre-deploy: `/scripts/kms-check oberon`.

anya_release: Locking the window. I'll open a dedicated go/no-go thread 30m before. If you see anything blocking before Thu 00:30 UTC, ping here. Otherwise we'll proceed with the scheduled job. :party_parrot: 

mike_sre: sim run complete at 01:32 UTC — baseline and burst profiles look good. Attaching short results: p50=120ms, p95=460ms, errors=0.2%. No infra errors.

laura_ops: Thanks — ACK go/no-go unless new alerts appear.

ben_pm: Ready to send customer note once canary passes first gate.

deploybot: deploybot: job 847321 started at 02:00:12 UTC. Canary step 1 (5%) initiated. Logs stream -> https://logs.redwood/847321.

anya_release: Monitoring. If auto-rollback triggers, we will follow the postmortem template and notify customer success immediately.

ops-runner: All set from ops. Holding watch on KV hit-rate and KMS checks.

kevin_infra: KV priming completed at 01:50 UTC. `kvprime` returned OK.

mike_sre: Observing metrics dashboard — canary p95 = 480ms, error rate 0.3% (within thresholds). Proceeding to 25% at +22m.

laura_ops: :thumbsup: all good from ops.

deploybot: deploybot: progressed to 25% at 02:22:30 UTC. Canary stable. Will wait 30m before final ramp.

anya_release: Thanks team — locking. Post-deploy checklist: confirm telemetry, release notes published, customer notified, and followup retro scheduled next Tue.

ops-runner: closing thread for now — will reopen if rollback or any manual hold.
